title: Moon Phase Simulator — Interactive 3D Model | Space Atlas
description: Use an interactive Moon phase simulator to move the Moon around Earth, jump to each major phase, and see the illuminated view from Earth.
ogDescription: Drag the Moon around Earth, jump to new, quarter, and full Moon, and compare orbit position with the phase seen from Earth.
jsonldDescription: An interactive Sun-Earth-Moon simulator showing orbit position, phase name, illuminated fraction, and the Moon's appearance from Earth.
